# Al Fareed Traders

> Wholesale distributors of premium card and board packaging materials located in Lahore, Pakistan.

## About Us
Established in 2005, Al Fareed Traders is a family-owned business supplying printing and packaging materials directly from our warehouse to printing presses.

## Core Products
- Bleach Board: Coated board used for tobacco, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and high-value packaging.
- Packages Boxboard: Multi-grammage boxboard used for matchboxes, tissue boxes, biscuits, tea, and pharmaceutical packaging.
- Century Boxboard: Premium boxboard for commercial printing and consumer packaging applications.
